integrity: The base underdamped transfer and ergotropy formulas, qubit half-population passivity criterion, and lossless zero intervals are prior results and explicitly credited. New result is their global dissipation-index classification, critical width and global positive-time limit. 4348 bounded checks support but do not replace the proof. No independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact result only for a resonant two-qubit GKLS charger with amplitude damping on the charger, an initially ground-state battery, and local ergotropy. A strictly positive work response can be experimentally negligible. Square-root law is at fixed lobe index, and the global Catalan law is at fixed coupling as loss vanishes. Stronger unlocated prior theory could subsume aspects of the classification.
title: Passivity-window staircase and universal square-root extinction in a lossy two-qubit battery
